faq.question: Which programming languages can I use to integrate with RapidScan?
faq.answer: RapidScan’s RESTful API is language-agnostic and works with Python, Node.js, Java, .NET, PHP, and more. SDKs and code samples are available for common stacks.

faq.question: How can I connect RapidScan to my ERP or CRM?
faq.answer: Use RapidScan’s webhooks to receive data in real-time, or poll the API to fetch processed results. You can then sync data with your ERP, CRM, or data lake.

faq.question: Can I define custom data fields for my documents?
faq.answer: Yes. You can define and train custom extraction fields using sample documents and configure rules via the RapidScan dashboard or API.

faq.question: How can I process large document batches programmatically?
faq.answer: Upload documents in bulk via API or SFTP endpoints. RapidScan processes them in parallel, returning results through webhook callbacks or data exports.

faq.question: What security standards does RapidScan follow for integrations?
faq.answer: RapidScan ensures enterprise-grade security with OAuth 2.0, API key authentication, IP whitelisting, role-based access, and full encryption at rest and in transit.
